''See also: [[Korr Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Korr serves as an advisor to [[Indirial]], though his true nature remains uncertain; he may be a distinct entity that utilizes a gold medallion with an amethyst or black gem center as a medium for communication. He is characterized by a sparse, dry, and cold manner of speaking, often communicating through telepathic whispers or by manifesting violet light and sparks. Korr typically remains silent unless he perceives a significant threat, at which point he provides warnings to his charge. While he usually resides within [[the House]] of [[Valinhall]], he can be summoned to appear as a medallion on a gold chain. He is known for his rare displays of emotion, such as worry or apology, and his guidance is vital to [[Indirial]]'s preparation for combat.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Korr exists as an advisor housed within a black gem located on [[Indirial's medallion]]. This presence can be summoned to appear upon a gold chain worn around [[Indirial]]'s neck.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Korr acts as an advisor to [[Indirial]]. This entity communicates by whispering into the mind to provide warnings regarding potential dangers.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Korr acts as an advisor to [[Indirial]], residing within a black gem on the man's medallion. This presence communicates with [[Indirial]] by whispering into his mind and providing warnings through violet flames.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Korr possesses the ability to perceive danger and communicates these threats through a violet flame seen in one's vision. Additionally, Korr can be summoned from [[Valinhall]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Residing within a black gem inside [[Indirial's medallion]], Korr serves as an advisor who communicates by whispering warnings directly into [[Indirial]]'s mind. These warnings manifest as a violet flame appearing in the corner of one's vision. Korr can be summoned from [[Valinhall]] to appear on a gold chain worn around [[Indirial]]'s neck. While dangling from this chain, Korr maintains the ability to perceive danger, such as seeing a violet flame at the tip of [[Zakareth]]'s spear.}}
